Candidate 64d8b648 (parent dc11c774, one file, +2/-5) deletes those 5 lines, replaces them with a 2-line comment, and keeps signer_seeds built from the owned locals maker_key, escrow_id and bump, so PDA safety now rests on invoke_signed re-deriving the signer address at CPI time plus the account-level constraint gifter_escrow_state.maker == maker.key(). No account attributes, tests, workflows or manifests change. The supplied evidence (validation-run) is the GitHub candidate-validation record for this exact SHA - status completed, conclusion success at fetch time, quoted as GitHub's record and not a claim of this draft - which builds the exact candidate and runs the trusted gifter-escrow-localnet fixture on a local validator; it exercises localnet only, not devnet.
